payload.title: UI Controller v2: P1 fixes + P2 treatment

p1_fixes.task_bound_admission: Strict approval validation: exact task/target/session/element matching, expiry enforcement, budget limits. Fail closed on any mismatch.
p1_fixes.atomic_leases: Generation-token leases with fencing. Atomic acquire via os.link. Release validates owner+token+generation. Stale tokens cannot affect new leases.
p1_fixes.uncertain_effects: Durable action journal. Dispatch journaled before request. Replay blocked while effect uncertain. No auto-retry.

payload.p2_treatment: PID-unique temps, bounded reads (1MB cap), sanitized errors, surfaced cleanup failures, checkpoint autosave.
payload.tests: 32/32 pass offline. Covers all P1 fixes (admission strictness, lease atomicity/fencing, journal replay blocking) and P2 items.
payload.design_doc: DESIGN_V2.md documents what changed, why, and what v2 does NOT do.
payload.not_yet: No live input. No Drive task action plan yet (separate). No automatic handoff — awaiting your review.
